title: Follow nearest-center assignments and mean updates
description: You trace scratch K-means from sampled observations to its cluster display.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You generate two-dimensional observations around each of three specified centers using the supplied group size. Stacking A, B, and C creates X_km.
You choose K distinct data rows as initial centers. Each iteration computes squared distances and assigns every row to its nearest center.

steps.question: What happens when a cluster receives no observations?
steps.answer: Its new center remains centers[k]. A populated cluster instead receives the mean of its assigned rows.

steps.description: You stop when the new centers are close to the old centers or the iteration limit ends. The call requests three clusters with the supplied seed.
You color observations by their returned labels and overlay the returned centers as large x markers. Both axes use the original feature coordinates.
